Scope: Pure CLR fixtures: math, protocol/transport/session, resource keys, layout/motion, host IDs and atomic world transfer, visual descriptors, slow producer commits and lifecycle generation fencing. Preview identity survives camera/distance and temporary visual loss; manual reselection retains replay fences; terminal roster updates and sampling hide reasons are covered. Native render stability, destroyed-part recovery, actual hit/capture and two-game world acceptance need separate game evidence.
